sources.snippet: Download DiffSinger for free. Singing Voice Synthesis via Shallow Diffusion Mechanism. DiffSinger is an open-source PyTorch implementation of a diffusion-based acoustic model for singing-voice synthesis (SVS) and also text-to-speech (TTS) in a related variant.
